subtitle: Organize Photos by Swiping
description:
Picky Saver helps you declutter your photo library with a simple, satisfying swipe. No cloud uploads, no accounts — just you and your photos.

Swipe right to keep, swipe left to mark for deletion. Review your choices anytime, restore photos you changed your mind about, and permanently delete when you're ready.

Features:
• Swipe-based photo organization — fast, fun, and intuitive
• Browse photos by month
• "To Be Deleted" album lets you review before permanently removing
• Undo anytime — nothing is deleted until you say so
• Dark mode support
• Fully accessible with VoiceOver and TalkBack
• No accounts, no cloud, no tracking — your photos stay on your device
keywords: photo organizer, declutter photos, photo cleaner, swipe photos, delete photos, photo manager, storage cleaner
